bodyFingerprint: MD5 of pg_proc.prosrc UTF-8 after CRLF-to-LF conversion only; lone carriage returns remain significant; includes complete function body, not just function names
catalogQuery:
WITH canvas_tables AS (
  SELECT c.oid, c.relname, c.relkind, c.relpersistence FROM pg_catalog.pg_class AS c
  JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
  WHERE n.nspname = current_schema() AND c.relname IN ('Canvas','CanvasImportAsset','CanvasSavedAssetUse','CanvasRun','CanvasJobAssetUse','CanvasGcLease')
), inventory AS (
  SELECT 'table'::text AS kind, t.relname::text AS name, jsonb_build_object('kind',t.relkind,'persistence',t.relpersistence) AS definition FROM canvas_tables AS t
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'column', t.relname || '.' || a.attname,
    jsonb_build_object('type',format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),'nullable',NOT a.attnotnull,'default',pg_get_expr(d.adbin,d.adrelid))
  FROM canvas_tables AS t JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute AS a ON a.attrelid=t.oid
  LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attrdef AS d ON d.adrelid=t.oid AND d.adnum=a.attnum
  WHERE a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'enum', t.typname, jsonb_agg(e.enumlabel ORDER BY e.enumsortorder)
  FROM pg_catalog.pg_type AS t JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid=t.typnamespace
  JOIN pg_catalog.pg_enum AS e ON e.enumtypid=t.oid
  WHERE n.nspname=current_schema() AND t.typname IN ('CanvasImportAssetState','CanvasRunState','CanvasPutOutcome','CanvasDeleteOutcome') GROUP BY t.typname
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'index', c.relname, jsonb_build_object('table',t.relname,'unique',i.indisunique,'primary',i.indisprimary,'valid',i.indisvalid,'ready',i.indisready,'method',m.amname,
    'columns',(SELECT jsonb_agg(a.attname ORDER BY k.n) FROM unnest(i.indkey) WITH ORDINALITY AS k(attnum,n) JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute AS a ON a.attrelid=t.oid AND a.attnum=k.attnum WHERE k.n<=i.indnkeyatts),
    'options',to_jsonb(i.indoption::smallint[]),'expressions',i.indexprs IS NOT NULL,'predicate',i.indpred IS NOT NULL,'nullsNotDistinct',i.indnullsnotdistinct,'includedColumns',i.indnatts-i.indnkeyatts)
  FROM canvas_tables AS t JOIN pg_catalog.pg_index AS i ON i.indrelid=t.oid
  JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS c ON c.oid=i.indexrelid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_am AS m ON m.oid=c.relam
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'constraint', c.conname, jsonb_build_object('table',t.relname,'type',c.contype,'deferrable',c.condeferrable,'deferred',c.condeferred,'validated',c.convalidated)
    || CASE WHEN c.contype='c' THEN jsonb_build_object('expression',pg_get_expr(c.conbin,c.conrelid)) ELSE jsonb_build_object('columns',(SELECT jsonb_agg(a.attname ORDER BY k.n) FROM unnest(c.conkey) WITH ORDINALITY AS k(attnum,n) JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute AS a ON a.attrelid=t.oid AND a.attnum=k.attnum)) END
    || CASE WHEN c.contype='f' THEN jsonb_build_object('referenceTable',r.relname,'referenceCurrentSchema',rn.nspname=current_schema(),'referenceColumns',(SELECT jsonb_agg(a.attname ORDER BY k.n) FROM unnest(c.confkey) WITH ORDINALITY AS k(attnum,n) JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute AS a ON a.attrelid=c.confrelid AND a.attnum=k.attnum),'deleteAction',c.confdeltype,'updateAction',c.confupdtype,'matchType',c.confmatchtype) ELSE '{}'::jsonb END
  FROM canvas_tables AS t JOIN pg_catalog.pg_constraint AS c ON c.conrelid=t.oid
  LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class AS r ON r.oid=c.confrelid LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS rn ON rn.oid=r.relnamespace WHERE c.contype IN ('p','u','f','c')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'function', p.proname, jsonb_build_object('arguments',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(format_type(v.type,NULL) ORDER BY v.n) FROM unnest(p.proargtypes::oid[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS v(type,n)),'[]'::jsonb),
    'argumentNames',COALESCE(to_jsonb(p.proargnames[1:p.pronargs]),'[]'::jsonb),'defaultCount',p.pronargdefaults,'argumentDefaults',pg_get_expr(p.proargdefaults,0),
    'returnType',format_type(p.prorettype,NULL),'returnsSet',p.proretset,'outputColumns',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',p.proargnames[v.n],'type',format_type(v.type,NULL)) ORDER BY v.n) FROM unnest(p.proallargtypes) WITH ORDINALITY AS v(type,n) WHERE p.proargmodes[v.n] IN ('o','b','t')),'[]'::jsonb),
    'language',l.lanname,'volatility',p.provolatile,'securityDefiner',p.prosecdef,'strict',p.proisstrict,'config',to_jsonb(p.proconfig),'bodyMd5',md5(replace(p.prosrc,chr(13)||chr(10),chr(10))))
  FROM pg_catalog.pg_proc AS p JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace JOIN pg_catalog.pg_language AS l ON l.oid=p.prolang
  WHERE n.nspname=current_schema() AND left(p.proname,7)='canvas_'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'trigger', g.tgname, jsonb_build_object('table',t.relname,'function',p.proname,'functionCurrentSchema',n.nspname=current_schema(),'type',g.tgtype,'enabled',g.tgenabled,'deferrable',g.tgdeferrable,'deferred',g.tginitdeferred,'arguments',g.tgnargs,'condition',pg_get_expr(g.tgqual,g.tgrelid))
  FROM canvas_tables AS t JOIN pg_catalog.pg_trigger AS g ON g.tgrelid=t.oid
  JOIN pg_catalog.pg_proc AS p ON p.oid=g.tgfoid JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE NOT g.tgisinternal
)
SELECT kind, name, definition FROM inventory ORDER BY kind, name

definition.expression: (scene IS NULL AND "lastSaveId" IS NULL AND "lastSaveHash" IS NULL AND "lastSaveRevision" IS NULL AND "lastSavedAt" IS NULL) OR (scene IS NOT NULL AND "deletedAt" IS NULL AND "lastSaveId" IS NOT NULL AND "lastSaveHash" IS NOT NULL AND "lastSaveHash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND "lastSaveRevision" IS NOT NULL AND "lastSaveRevision" > 0 AND "lastSaveRevision" <= revision AND "lastSavedAt" IS NOT NULL)

kind = 'IMPORT' AND "byteLength" BETWEEN 1 AND 8388608 AND sha256 ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND "mimeType" IN ('image/png','image/jpeg','image/webp') AND length("storageLocation") > 0 AND length("storageEndpoint") > 0 AND length("storageRegion") > 0 AND length("storageBucket") > 0 AND length("storageKey") > 0
state <> 'READY' OR ("readyAt" IS NOT NULL AND "putOutcome" = 'CONFIRMED' AND "storageVersionId" IS NULL)
state NOT IN ('DELETING','DELETED') OR ("deleteToken" IS NOT NULL AND "deleteExpiresAt" IS NOT NULL AND "deleteAttempts" > 0)

(state = 'PREPARING' AND "originalJobId" IS NULL AND "liveJobId" IS NULL AND "committedAt" IS NULL AND "rejectedAt" IS NULL) OR (state = 'COMMITTED' AND "originalJobId" IS NOT NULL AND "committedAt" IS NOT NULL AND "rejectedAt" IS NULL) OR (state = 'REJECTED' AND "originalJobId" IS NULL AND "liveJobId" IS NULL AND "rejectionCode" IS NOT NULL AND "rejectedAt" IS NOT NULL)
id = 'canvas-imports' AND ((token IS NULL AND "expiresAt" IS NULL) OR (token IS NOT NULL AND "expiresAt" IS NOT NULL))
